outcomes: Demonstrate the ability to work in teams and interact collaboratively within a business organization.
Demonstrate effective communication practices utilized within a business environment.
Demonstrate the knowledge and skills to prepare accurate business statements and payrolls.
Demonstrate the knowledge and skill to manage a business in a legal manner.

notes: The catalog prints codes without a space (e.g. BUSAD2A); these match closed-list codes (e.g. BUSAD 2A), so catalog_addition is false.

Student completes either the CC-GE or Cal-GETC pattern.
An outcomes lead-in appears near the top with no outcomes under it; the four outcomes are taken from the Program Learning Outcomes section.
Career entry 'management position' comes from the description ('go straight into a management position'); reviewer may check whether it should count as a career.
